steps.content: [Town at the mountain's foot]

steps.speaker: Child A
steps.content: Brrr—my hands are like ice! With all this snow, I can't even see the top... And Shuang'er still hasn't sent any word.

steps.speaker: Child B
steps.content: Hey! Stop looking at the mountain! Your mom's running all over the village looking for you! The snow's gonna make the shed roof fall down. Come help!
A light tap lands on the back of her head. It's not hard, just a quick thump from the other child, but it's enough to break the spell as she stares, mesmerized, at the mountaintop.

steps.speaker: Child A
steps.content: But... aren't you worried about her?

steps.speaker: Child B
steps.content: It's Shuang'er we're talking about! She said she'd come back and tell us all the cool stuff from up there, so she will! You should worry more about your mom. When she hears you talking about that martial world stuff again... ooh, you're gonna get spanked!

steps.speaker: Child A
steps.content: My mom won't! She just says stories can't keep you warm.
As the child speaks, she hugs her thin jacket tight and crouches to fuss with the snow at her feet, working to smooth out the messy footprints.

steps.speaker: Child A
steps.content: Hey... those heroes who go up the mountain... they're not cold, right? 'Cause they have... inner power! Yeah! They just move it around inside and then, poof! They're all warm! Snow probably just melts when it gets near them! They're like... like warm stoves! So cool!

steps.speaker: Child B
steps.content: Yeah! Shuang'er's probably doing all that right now! Punching and kicking with them. So awesome!

The two children grin at each other, hoisting bundles of firewood nearly as tall as themselves onto their backs. They trudge unsteadily through the snow, laughing and chattering as they head toward the dimly glowing lights of home, their paths carving two jagged lines behind them in the knee-deep white.

The blizzard howls, swallowing their voices whole. This endless expanse of white lies like silver shackles, strangling the life from the mountain villages. Roads have vanished under the drifts, icicles hang like fangs from every eave, and between heaven and earth, nothing exists but the shrieking wind and swirling snow—not another soul stirs.
[Cave]

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Ugh... Ngh...
Shuang'er braces herself against the stone wall, her knuckles whitening as she grips the rock, forcing herself toward the entrance of the manor's hidden chamber.

Wave after wave of familiar, twisting pain tears through her chest. She knows neither the lingering poison nor Yin Yansheng could have driven her to such desperate straits. This agony is all too familiar. It's the chronic illness that has shadowed her since birth, now counting down the final moments of her life.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: Are you out of your mind?! Even your parents couldn't cure what's inside you, and you're gambling with the time you have left?
This isn't a gamble. I've made my choice. Some things in this world... simply can't be tolerated.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: Stubborn as a mule... You were a headstrong little terror as a child, and now you're marching yourself straight into a den of wolves...

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: I've failed them... Your parents trusted me to keep you safe, and I couldn't even talk sense into you. So if you're set on this, if this is truly your path, then please, at least, take care of yourself.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: If the doctor could see me now... he'd probably be so furious he'd tear out every last strand of that white hair of his...
Shuang'er presses her forehead against the cold stone door, using it to keep her failing body from collapsing.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: The children... they are still waiting for me to come back with the incredible stories from Northsnow Manor...

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: This world... what's real and what's not... the dark and the light...

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: I promised I'd tell them... with my own voice...

Only once she has pushed through the door and hidden herself in the dark chamber does she finally release a long-held breath. She empties her inner pouch of all its medicine bottles and swallows every last pill.
Then, sitting cross-legged, she closes her eyes and steadies her breathing.
[Guest Room, Day]

The entire night passes as you wait, but Shuang'er never appears. You search every accessible corner of the manor—the corridors, the courtyards, even the area around the kitchen stove—yet find no sign of her.
Defeated, you return to the guest room, torn by two fears: that some terrible fate has befallen her, or that she might return and, not finding you there, you will miss each other again.
But just as the first light of dawn begins to creep across the sky, a knock sounds on the guest room door.
Forgive the early hour, young friend. An urgent matter has arisen. Might I have a word?
The visitor's attitude seems fairly gentle.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Lady Ji? What's the matter?

steps.speaker: Ji Guining
steps.content: Ah, you're already awake. That simplifies things.

steps.speaker: Ji Guining
steps.content: We... may have uncovered a lead on the culprit for these recent attacks. We were hoping you might join us to discuss it.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The culprit?
Bang! Before you can even think, the door beside you is violently kicked open by a tremendous force. Yin Yansheng brazenly barges into your guest room.

steps.speaker: Yin Yansheng
steps.content: Discuss?! Lady Ji, what is there to discuss with one who harbors a murderer?! The moment I came closer, I sensed it! This room... It reeks of misfortune! The shadow of bloodshed lurks here. There is evil afoot!!
